name: CESifo Area Conference on Public Economics 2027
organizer: CESifo; scientific organizers Claus Thustrup Kreiner and Andreas Peichl
conf_dates_note: CESifo Junior Workshop on Public Economics on 21 April 2027 (separate call for PhD students near completion and early-career postdocs).
submission_requirements: Papers on any topic in public economics; preference given to complete papers. Each paper may be submitted to only one CESifo Area Conference. Submission via the online form linked from the event page. The 2027 call welcomes submissions from senior and junior researchers and does not state a CESifo-network restriction (earlier calls were limited to network members).
keynotes: Xavier Jaravel (LSE), keynote; Juan Carlos Suárez Serrato (Stanford University), Richard Musgrave Lecture
